description: This file implements a WebRTC transport layer for Pipecat, including classes for managing WebRTC connections, media tracks, and transport logic for both input and output streams. It uses aiortc, OpenCV, and av libraries to handle real-time audio/video streaming, messaging, and client connection events.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCCallbacks
classes.description: Defines callback handlers for WebRTC events such as app messages and client connection status.

classes.name: RawAudioTrack
classes.description: Custom audio track for WebRTC, manages audio frame buffering and timing.

classes.name: RawVideoTrack
classes.description: Custom video track for WebRTC, manages video frame buffering and conversion.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCClient
classes.description: Handles WebRTC peer connection, media stream management, and event handling.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCInputTransport
classes.description: Manages incoming media streams and application messages from WebRTC peers.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCOutputTransport
classes.description: Manages outgoing media streams and messages to WebRTC peers.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCTransport
classes.description: Main transport class integrating input/output transports with WebRTC connection handling.

methods.name: _convert_frame
methods.description: Converts video frame array to RGB format based on source format.

methods.name: read_video_frame
methods.description: Asynchronously reads video frames from WebRTC connection, converts to RGB, and yields UserImageRawFrame.

methods.name: read_audio_frame
methods.description: Asynchronously reads audio frames from WebRTC connection, resamples if needed, and yields InputAudioRawFrame.

methods.name: write_audio_frame
methods.description: Sends an audio frame to WebRTC connection.

methods.name: write_video_frame
methods.description: Sends a video frame to WebRTC connection.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the client with transport parameters and initial frame.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes WebRTC connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from WebRTC peer.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends application message over WebRTC.

methods.name: _handle_client_connected
methods.description: Handles WebRTC client connection event, initializes media tracks.

methods.name: _handle_peer_disconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup on peer disconnection.

methods.name: _handle_client_closed
methods.description: Handles cleanup on client connection close.

methods.name: _handle_app_message
methods.description: Processes incoming application messages.

methods.name: _can_send
methods.description: Checks if connection is ready to send data.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Property indicating if WebRTC connection is active.

methods.name: is_closing
methods.description: Property indicating if connection is in process of closing.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Returns the input transport instance.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns the output transport instance.

methods.name: send_image
methods.description: Sends an image frame through WebRTC.

methods.name: send_audio
methods.description: Sends an audio frame through WebRTC.

methods.name: capture_participant_video
methods.description: Triggers capture of participant's video stream.

methods.name: capture_participant_audio
methods.description: Triggers capture of participant's audio stream.
